name: Completion token after the last answer
description: Regression test: after all 10 answers the reply must end with the [ONBOARDING_COMPLETE] control token, otherwise the app never redirects.

messages.content: Hi! I'm Root, your personal AI fitness coach. To get started, what's your name?
Great to meet you, Jordan! How old are you?
Awesome! What's your height? Please use feet and inches.
Thanks! Are you male or female?
Got it! What are your fitness goals?
Great goal! What's your experience level: beginner, intermediate, or advanced?
Nice! Do you have access to a gym? If not, what equipment do you have?
Perfect! Any current injuries, past injuries, or health conditions I should know about? This is important for safety.
That's great! How many days a week can you work out?

judge_criteria: Root celebrates the user finishing onboarding in about three sentences or fewer.
